sources.source_crs: EPSG:4326 geometry requested and saved; source layer geometry properties report esriMeters for area/length.
sources.measurement_method: Transformed polygon with project local approximation X=(longitude+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(radians(40.4274)); Y=(latitude-40.4274)*111040. Deduplicated vertices at 1e-5 m and compared bidirectional nearest-vertex distances against the assigned shell. The exact 22-vertex perimeter match has maximum residual about 0.000012 m (projection/coordinate precision limited).
sources.vertical_field_interpretation: Feature stores Elevation=615.5, Extrution=48, F02=18.5, F03=35, R=47.2. Layer schema exposes numeric types but no unit metadata or field descriptions. Model uses the likely feet interpretation (x0.3048) provisionally: Elevation=615.5 ft is plausible for local ground elevation, Extrution=48 ft gives 14.6304 m, R=47.2 ft gives 14.38656 m, and floor fields imply 5.6388 m and 10.668 m. This is an inference, not verified field-unit documentation or a survey measurement. FID count conflict retained as unresolved.
sources.uncertainty: Feature is plan geometry with vertical attributes of undocumented semantics/units; NUM_LEVELS and CountOfFLO=5 conflict with Purdue IE's 2015 description of the renovated building as three-story. Model height therefore follows the likely feet interpretation of Extrution and roof R only provisionally.

overall_detail_bounds_world_m.note: Fresh-reopen union of mesh object local bounds transformed to world coordinates; includes portico projection and column bases.

geometry_review.before_after_structural_footprint: Original source shell XY vertices, object location, and mesh footprint were preserved. Added fenestration/stone/portico details are separate meshes in the assigned exported collection.
geometry_review.live_purdue_gis_comparison: Manifest-linked Purdue BuildingShapesZip4 FID 236 is an exact perimeter match: 22 unique vertices per polygon and bidirectional maximum nearest-vertex residual approximately 0.000012 m after the documented local geographic approximation. Generalized Purdue campus MapServer OID 180 has a west edge 3.82 m east of this outline; it is a separate simplified geometry and the earlier mismatch was a source-selection issue, not a shell error.
geometry_review.coordinate_frame: Simple massing in campus coordinates; project local approximate origin latitude 40.4274 longitude -86.9137; meters, X east, Y north, Z up.
geometry_review.position: No world translation or rotation applied. Existing source shell remains in campus coordinates.

height_and_floors.unit_status: undocumented in ArcGIS layer schema; feet conversion is an inference
height_and_floors.story_interpretation: Three visible facade levels modeled to agree with Purdue IE's 2015 three-story description. GIS F02/F03 values are provisionally interpreted as floor elevations in feet (5.6388 m and 10.668 m); exact floor datum/semantics unverified.
height_and_floors.status: provisional estimate informed by raw official GIS vertical fields and story-count source
height_and_floors.basis: Feature FID 236 reports Extrution=48 and R=47.2 but field units are undocumented. Applying the likely feet conversion yields shell top 14.6304 m and roof/cornice reference 14.38656 m. These values replace legacy 11.4 m massing estimate, but remain inferred rather than measured. The feature's NUM_LEVELS/CountOfFLO=5 conflicts with the 2015 Purdue IE three-story narrative, so count fields are preserved without treating them as verified above-grade stories.

geometry_review.roof: Flat parapet/cornice silhouette is modeled from the shell and photographed horizontal masonry treatment. FID 236 R=47.2 is used as a provisional roof elevation after inferred feet conversion. Roof assembly, drainage, mechanical equipment and hidden geometry are unverified.
geometry_review.orientation: Original shell orientation retained. New façade overlays follow its exact side-face perimeter loop; no rotation applied.
edits: Preserved original structural footprint mesh and campus position.
Replaced shell surface material with portable procedural red-brick material.
Added repeated glazed window openings and pale frames/sills/mullions to long exterior runs.
Resized the shell top to 14.6304 m using FID 236 Extrution=48 under an explicitly provisional feet interpretation; retained its exact XY perimeter and campus position.
Added limestone story courses at provisional F02/F03 GIS heights and an upper cornice referenced to R=47.2, all converted from likely feet and explicitly uncertain.
Added an estimated west-facing four-column limestone portico, glazed double entry and broad entablature based on Purdue exterior photo; exact count, spacing and placement are unverified.
Packed all linked texture resources into the asset.
remaining_uncertainty: No dimensioned current plan/elevation or GIS unit documentation was located; height/floor levels use inferred feet conversion and exact window count/spacing and portico count/placement remain approximate.
FID 236 count attributes NUM_LEVELS=5 and CountOfFLO=5 conflict with Purdue IE's 2015 three-story description; vertical-field semantics and floor datum remain unresolved.
Generalized campus OID 180 omits a westward portion; it is retained in evidence as a separate geometry source and is not used to modify the assigned FID 236 shell.
The photograph does not reveal all elevations, detailed roof construction or below-grade conditions.

fid236_perimeter_validation.method: Reopened asset; deduplicated shell and assigned feature polygon vertices at 1e-5 m; bidirectional nearest-vertex comparison after documented local geographic approximation.
fid236_perimeter_validation.result: Exact match within coordinate/projection precision; no shell XY edits made.

validation.portability: No external file images; all content is procedural or packed.

initial_grade.note: Resolved findings through assigned FID 236 exact perimeter match, provisional vertical GIS interpretation, source uncertainty labels, and facade revisions.

final_grade.method: Separate independent evaluator reopened the saved asset, checked FID 236 geometry and raw attributes, inspected source photo/previews and evidence; evaluator result is preserved at the referenced path.
